description: VerseDB helps existing VerseDB Pro members search comics, inspect issues and market prices, review their collections and reading progress, and track upcoming releases. Users can also add or update owned copies, follow series, manage curated lists, and publish reviews or ratings. Collection copies and lists may be publicly visible; confirm the intended target and visibility before making changes.

defaultPrompt: Find missing issues in my comic collection.
Show upcoming releases for the series on my pull list.
Help me build a private reading list for a comic story arc.
